reasons.decision_clarity: The external behaviour is fixed: write root when allocator-root is unspecified (D-1), the conditional branch to remove, and the functions and constant to delete (W-1 :107). The interface is fixed: test reversal and renaming (D-2), the ingested_pages inclusion rule and path normalisation (D-8, W-6), and the 'project root' meaning (D-10). The merge failure policy is fixed: union applies only to log.md and index.md (D-13), and the .gitattributes block is fixed byte-for-byte (D-4/D-14). Storage is fixed: the hub working tree, uncommitted (D-5). No choice is left to the implementer.
reasons.executability: Every Work item names an owner, a P1 group, no predecessor, and file ownership, and their files do not overlap. Each one gives line positions, the exact replacement text, and CLI flag restrictions, for example index/log accept only --brain-path (brain_tool.py:1563-1575 and :1596-1605 cited at :101 and :111). No raw external agent or CLI call is specified. Wrappers such as brain-tool run.sh are used.
reasons.recoverability: Release and recovery (:127-130) sets the order: commit the bundle first, then merge, then resolve conflicts with D-15 if any, then run index again. It also gives failure paths: if W-1 goes RED, revert the code and docs together; W-5 is uncommitted, so it can be restored with checkout after user approval. The H-3 and H-5 risks are covered by a warning and an exact path list in the report.
